summary.en-US: Offline buffering, Focus Mode and auto-scroll for comics, webtoons and novels.

description.en-US:
Tunnel Reader is currently in beta.

The core reading features are functional, including adaptive cache-first buffering/offline reading, reading resume, Focus Mode and auto-scroll for comics and novels.

Focus Mode can temporarily hide common page chrome and intrusive overlays while keeping the reading content and Tunnel Reader controls intact.

This early public release is intended for real-world testing across more websites and devices. Small compatibility and interface refinements may follow.

release_notes.en-US: Adds Focus Mode: a reversible, per-site option that hides common headers, navigation, sidebars and intrusive fixed/sticky overlays while preserving reading content. Also polishes the AMO beta metadata and removes an unconfirmed control-button bug note.

version.approval_notes: Tunnel Reader is built from the human-readable TypeScript sources in src/ using the open-source esbuild dependency pinned in package-lock.json. Reproduction commands are documented in extension/README.md. The submission includes a source archive of the exact Git commit. The extension has no analytics, telemetry, remote code, or Reader backend. Broad HTTP/HTTPS matching is required because reader-page detection is site-agnostic; the content script exits early on pages that do not look like supported reading pages.
